disagreements.description: Where the readers pulled opposite ways, or a note you couldn't settle

paragraph.description: The paragraph ID alone, exactly as labelled in the English given: p12, or p21–p23 for a group the translator joined

send_up.description: True only where the reading doesn't settle it and being wrong would matter

beyond_this_part.description: What you learned in this part that changes how an earlier part should read (a person, a word, what a scene means), for the house to take back to it. When nothing does, the list is empty

finding.description: What should change, in a sentence

why.description: What in this part shows it
